import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedShuffleSplit
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from catboost import CatBoostClassifier

# Setup paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUB_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Prepare features and target
drop_cols = ["f_27", "id", "target"]
y = train_df["target"]
X_train = train_df.drop(columns=drop_cols)
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=drop_cols)

# Ensure categorical features are treated as objects to force CatBoost to handle them natively
cat_features = ["f_29", "f_30"]
for col in cat_features:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype(str)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype(str)

# Stratified train/validation split
split = StratifiedShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
train_idx, val_idx = next(split.split(X_train, y))

X_tr, X_val = X_train.iloc[train_idx], X_train.iloc[val_idx]
y_tr, y_val = y.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

print(f"Train size: {len(X_tr)}, Val size: {len(X_val)}")

# Initialize and train CatBoost model
model = CatBoostClassifier(
    iterations=1500,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    depth=6,
    l2_leaf_reg=3,
    loss_function="Logloss",
    eval_metric="AUC",
    random_seed=42,
    verbose=False,
    thread_count=-1,
)

model.fit(
    X_tr,
    y_tr,
    cat_features=cat_features,
    eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    use_best_model=True,
)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
y_val_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_prob)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Save submission
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["target"] = test_prob
submission.to_csv(SUB_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUB_PATH}")
